result.title: Auditing Identity and Timing Signals in Operational Logs
result.comment: 28 pages. Supplementary code and results included. WhoWhen library: https://github.com/mojolearn/whowhen
result.summary: Models that predict events from operational logs, such as sepsis in ICU records or failures in hard drives, can score well by recognizing which patient or drive a record came from, or when it was recorded, instead of predicting the event. I introduce two simple audits that measure how much of this information a dataset carries before any event-prediction model is trained, and apply them to seven public datasets in six domains. One asks whether a classifier can tell that two records came from the same unit; the other asks which of two records from the same unit came later. Under the stated nulls, both have expected AUC 0.5. In ICU data, the identity audit flags a common preprocessing step: carrying the last measurement forward raises identity AUC from 0.916 to 0.993. On a 12-hour sepsis forecasting task, carrying forward makes a model look 0.163 AUC better than raw values when a patient's hours are split between training and test, but only 0.046 better when patients are held out. The exaggeration under patient overlap also appears in a second ICU dataset with mortality as the outcome. On the sepsis task, a chronological control with complete follow-up, in which training sees only a patient's earlier, resolved hours, shows no positive mean overlap gap. Timing is a strong predictor: with complete follow-up, hour of stay and measurement counts alone, with no clinical value, score 0.761 on held-out patients, and adding the raw clinical values changes that by +0.018. Outside the ICU, 95% of drives and 75% of loans have records on both sides of a calendar cut, and the overlap gap persists under a calendar split. The audits show which features and preprocessing choices to check; the evaluation protocol decides the consequences. I release the code, a library that runs the audits on any table with a unit column and a time column, and a guide to using the audits.

AI.brief_summary: 提出两种在训练事件预测模型之前即可运行的审计：判别两条记录是否来自同一单元、以及同一单元的两条记录谁更晚，用于量化数据集本身携带的身份与时间信号；在六个领域七个公开数据集上揭示了前向填充抬高身份 AUC、以及患者/样本重叠如何夸大模型提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「同单元判别＋时间顺序判别」的轻量探针可供核查 latent 或中间表示是否携带身份、时序等任务无关捷径，从而判断 VLM 推理收益是否真的来自视觉证据；这一迁移只是可能，需结合具体多模态设置核查。
